steps.name: The answer a gardener wants
steps.objective: Talk to the person you met at “Orcarium Secluded Place”, then go to “Atlas Garden” and meet [Metheus]. Then, report the quest to [Gendia] in “Dragon Castle.”

lines.text: (The sounds of the world at a standstill begin to be heard little by little in the ears of %s, who seemed to have fallen into a deep sleep.)
(As %s quietly opens his eyes and looks, the figure of Gendia appears, looking around in confusion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're back.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: %s, you weren't here a moment ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gendia, I’m glad you did.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Are you lucky? A little while ago, I met Lord Aaron and asked him about my subject's whereabouts... .

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Where did Lord Aaron go again? No, this is… . iced coffee… .
(JN seems to have remembered something and sits down helplessly.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: %s… . I didn't want to recall those memories again, but now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I'm sorry. Because it feels so similar to back then... .
(Zien stands up and looks blankly at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Today's mood is similar to the day I was tied to the altar with a curse spell.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: The dagger imbued with the power of Demon Lord Lux wanted my blood and scarred me.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: And Aaron was holding that sword just a moment ago. %s must have seen that too, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: There must be a reason why you appeared here before my eyes, where there was no trace just a moment ago.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I don't think this is normal, but please trust me when I tell you this. please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where should I start? . It's going to be a long story.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then… .
(I tell Jien what happened in the Atlas Garden, the wisdom of Kaina, the emperor of Sylvaria, and even the story of my visit to Vigrid, the world behind the scenes.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: It's full of things I don't understand, but I'll believe it. These are the words of %s, and I have also been among the most unbelievable things in the world.
(Zien raises his head and looks at the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I had been stronger, I would have saved him... .

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: No. That was what the witch planned to do. Levy… . Oh, even if he, my subject, was as strong as %s, he wouldn't have gotten away easily.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I should have told him about the witch in advance, but I didn't... . It's my fault too.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: … Anyway, we'll have to keep looking for him. But %s… .

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: The Emperor of the Sylvaria Empire said that his foresight has never been wrong, right?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: If I had just watched, I would have died or been injured, and if I couldn't watch that and came out, things would have gone wrong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . So now I have to find a way to solve this situation.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: The front and back sides are divided around one person. It's something you have to do from the front as if you came back after solving the problem behind the scenes... .

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: %s, I need to go to Atlas Garden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: There is something I would like to ask the gatekeeper of Atlas Garden. Maybe we can get an answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What are you trying to ask?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's going to be dangerous, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: It's okay. Don't worry too much. I won't be a burden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Gendia. Then follow me.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: We just touched it and a large water droplet floated up, sending us here. I was down there a little while ago... .
(Zien looks at the Laran Road below the garden.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: %s, there is someone on top of the building over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .
(As Jian said, someone is looking at this place from a white building built on a water tank.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gendia, step back.
Click, click.
(Every time Metheus walks slowly, a characteristic clanging sound like a mechanical device is heard.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Metheus… .
(God's creature, immersed in a beautiful silver-gray light, flaps its wings powerfully and approaches the two people.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: A being created by God to protect the garden... .

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “Follower of God. When we meet again, we need to be prepared... … … .」
(Metheus, who spoke as if warning, stops moving for a moment. It looks like he is trying to move again, but he soon stops again.)
Click, click.
(The form of Metheus, which has stopped, repeatedly changes into an unknown shape as if it were distorted. Then, the moment it stops, it creates a fan of blades in its hand and creates a large wind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gendia, avoid it!
(Adventurer sees that Gendia is hiding behind the structure in the garden, and runs towards the blade-like wind caused by Metheus.)
(And then attempts to attack Metheus, who is about to change into a twisted form again.)
Kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwak!
(The moment %s's attack touches Metheus' wings, a huge whirlpool arises and blows away everything nearby.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… … .

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: %s, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Giendia, please step aside. Metheus' attack continues... .

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Look over there, %s.
(%s's gaze moves following the direction Zien points to. Metheus is floating in the sky, gazing somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you looking at?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: What's in the west?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is a village along the Laran Road. Luria Village… .  No way, the village… ?
(At that moment, Metheus flies upward and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, where did you go?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: %s, stay calm… . Metheus will not leave this place. To be precise, you can't leave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I'll let you know when I talk to Metheus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . I didn't think it would be easy to meet and talk to Metheus, but as expected... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Giendia, Metheus's condition is strange right now, so I don't think we can avoid battle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, once you spot Metheus, avoid him as far away as possible. Did you know?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I understand. Then let's hurry as much as possible.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I feel like I don't have much time to be here... .
(As expected by %s, a battle occurs as soon as you meet Metheus, who feels different from before.)
(As multiple attacks collide, Metheus stops moving and looks at Zien, who was hiding from afar.)
Click, click.
(Metheus retreats quickly with an odd sound.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: %s, stop.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Gendia?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Metheus stopped moving... . Metheus, are you listening to me?
(Metheus nods quietly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't want to fight, do you?

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「… That's right. “Followers of God.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Follower of God, call me by name instead of that. Isn't it long?

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “Your name is %s…? ?」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「… %s. “Who is the person next to you?”

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Gn from the continent of Gndia... Let’s say this.

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “JN… . “You shouldn’t stay here for long.”

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I know. So I decided to just listen to the story and go right away.

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “Without realizing it, I thought you were a god. JN, your time… , %s's time is all slightly off... .」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “I can feel the air of a world that has stopped in the twilight from you… .」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “So when you approached, my time was distorted. And all the time in the garden was shaken… .」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “At this moment, when even the star god cannot touch it, if you try to meet the star god, this moment will all stop.”

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “I have to go back. “You have to turn it around.”

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Is there a way to turn it around?

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “There is no truth here. The truth of time is buried elsewhere.”

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: By any chance, do you know where it is?

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「… I am a gardener. The tears of time have disappeared somewhere.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tears of time?
(Metheus spreads his folded wings and rises into the air.)

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「… JN, you will know. “The place where your time begins.”

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: … There is an answer, Metheus. thank you.
(As Jien expresses his gratitude, Metheus turns his back and flies away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Giendia, is that it?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Metheus told me all he knew, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? You didn't say where Metheus was.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: That place is where time started to go out of sync: Yongjeseong Fortress.

steps.name: Clues left by truth
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Jiandia] in 「Dragon Emperor Castle」, and go to see [Gi] in 「Dragon Emperor Hall」. 
2. After the conversation, return to [Gendia] in “Dragon Castle” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I never thought I'd see Yongje Castle again from this spot... … .
(Jian must be so overcome with emotion that he cannot continue speaking as he looks at Yong Je-seong.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's really been a while since I've been here.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: In the meantime, a lot has happened to me and %s.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: The ghosts of time that filled Yongje Castle have all been cleared away... . I want to continue to renovate it and make it a place where people can come and go someday.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm going to meet Kii, so if you have anything to say, please leave a message.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Thanks to Gendia, I think I can see what I should do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gii, you may know that these are the tears of time that Metheus was talking about.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I have a lot to tell you, Kii, but I’ll save it for now. I'm so sorry... .

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I tried a lot, but I couldn't even find a way to get Kii to come out because I was running out of time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, don't be too hard on yourself.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Thank you, %s… .

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Then just tell me I miss you so much... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have to hurry….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's definitely come back, but the reason everything feels so slow probably means that this situation isn't normal...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (We have to solve it quickly….)
(The foolish dragon was unable to ascend to the throne of the emperor who once pursued past glory, and only vague traces of his struggle remain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the same here. Because it is also a place where no one can enter.
(At that moment, a man walks slowly, bathed in light coming through a broken crack in the building.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hi Kii.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: It's you... , %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been? sorry. I couldn't keep my promise to find a way and come back.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: … Meanwhile?
(Kii looks at %s’s face with an incomprehensible expression.)

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: How long has it been since you came to visit me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: About a year... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I see. Time goes by so fast, but I feel like time is really slow.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I can't help it. Even this will get used to it someday. At least it would be better than being trapped in time and falling asleep.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: By the way, %s… .
(Ki looks a little surprised as if he sensed something from %s.)

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Your energy feels different than before. It's different from simply becoming stronger.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: It's like I'm moving while trapped in a time barrier... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: %s, I will help you. So tell me what happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Gii… . Here's how it happened... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly talk about what is happening now, starting from when I went to another continent and met Iris after Yongjeseong's work was over.)
(Ki is very surprised after hearing what happened to %s.)

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: To go through so much... . Are you really okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Even if you say it's okay, you won't be deceived. sorry. By the way, to fix what you're going through... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Wait, give me time to think. It won't take long. It only takes a moment.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: It's time for the front... .
(While Kii was thinking, he opens his closed eyes and looks at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I don't know if this will be a clue... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Could you tell me?

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I spread a time barrier at Yongje Castle to block the flow of time.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: The reason why this method, which was taboo, was able to be used is because of the blood of the dragon passed down from our ancestors.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Even though the dragon is a great and mysterious animal, it is difficult to shake the time given to life... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: However, this information was left behind in a banned book that recorded methods for dealing with the time barrier.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: “The dragon that looked into God’s realm shook time, and someone whispered to gain space. And in their hands, time became distorted. … … .」

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: At the time, I didn't know exactly what it was about, so I just ignored it. Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this a dragon who has touched the power of God?...)

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Maybe the reason my father fell for Lux's trick was because he wanted to become a god... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I'm sorry. I guess that's all I can tell you. If you knew the dragons of ancient times, you might hear a different story... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, a dragon from ancient times? There is one person.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Amazing, a dragon from ancient times... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is someone who helped me from another continent. He has been doing the work of Goddess Ceres and Goddess Gaia for a long time.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I can trust someone like that. Maybe he will give you the answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Kii. I need to ask about something related to the time barrier. And the way Kii comes out... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: No, %s. Solving the tasks given to you comes first rather than me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later then. I will try my best to come see you sooner next time.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: It's okay. Anyway, the passage of time doesn't mean much to me right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. Gendia had something to tell you. I miss you a lot... .

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Got it. And for Gendia… . No, I don't know when, but I'll tell you about it myself.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: %s. If you need my help, come back here. Then I wish you luck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Gii.
(Ki slowly walks out of the room with a greeting from %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I feel like something is coming together little by little... . Let's say hello to Gendia right away and then go to Adkina.

steps.name: to be sure
steps.objective: After talking to [Giandia] in “Dragon Castle,” visit [Adkina] in “Flaming Wheel” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I'm glad you got a clue. Kii seems to be doing well too... .
(Zien’s expression becomes lighter as he listens to the story.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I know where to go, I'll go right away, Giendia.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I will find a way to find my subject's whereabouts. And what happened with Chairman Aaron… .

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I don't know what state the Majesty of the Sylvaria Empire is in right now, so I won't be able to move easily... .

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: … I hope that %s's time will return to normal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, I'll see you later then.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Take care, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I guess Adkina is at the Burning Wheel, right? I have to go and talk to her first.)

steps.name: One who glimpsed the realm of God
steps.objective: After talking to [Adkina] in “The Burning Wheel,” report the quest to [Mathias] in “Lulia Village.”

lines.text: (At the border of many worlds, on one side of the place where they stayed for the decisive battle, only one gigantic being remains, guarding the place.)
(The being that was resting for a moment raises its head quietly, as if sensing someone's presence. Then, its eyes, shining like yellow jewels, meet the approaching person.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been, Adkina?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm always doing well. Recently, with Gaia's blessing, I briefly visited Zenadia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, that's great. How was it?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I was very happy just breathing the air there. I talked a lot with the sisters and priests who guard Zenadia.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: They called me their senior, but it was a bit of an unfamiliar expression. haha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's quite a distance from Eastland to the continent of Gyendia. How did you get there?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I returned to my original self, flew, and landed on Zenadia. Don't worry too much. I have my own way of not revealing myself.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I wanted to stay a little longer, but I couldn't leave this place empty for long, so I came back right away. The purification work in Avalon and other nearby areas has not yet been completed... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I saw the spirit that was moving actively slow down. When I hurried back, the air I felt inside was different from before.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: So, I asked Shinik, who discovered this place, and he said that time was shaken... . hmm… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The look on your face makes me think you know something. I feel like I have something to say too. Now, tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Adkina. The reason I came here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Adkina briefly what happened so far.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: That's your situation... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're not surprised.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: In this land where life, including you and me, lives, many truly unexplainable things happen.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I won't deny that there are things I've become dull from spending a long time.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Anyway, if that's your situation, you should hurry. I tell you what I know.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Because I know the dragon who looked into the realm of God, as the person who opened the barrier of time said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Sanak, he was a Plutonian dragon like me.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: He, like me, is a being who was awakened by Ceres' will to protect the life of the earth.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The twilight years when the Old Gods and the Twisted One clashed with strong emotions, and the period of confusion when the Beast appeared.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: At a time when everything that was visible was disappearing day by day, and when everyone had a hard time enduring the pain, Sanak happened to open the realm of God and look into it.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: When he saw that realm, he cursed many gods, including Ceres, and tried to kill one of them.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: There was no way a life that was only a little strong could be a match for God. The god forgave Sanak and banished him far away, hoping that Ceres would not be sad.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: And although Sanak decided to retrieve the items he had taken from the god's realm and return, the god could not return.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The day when Beast led the world’s gods to extinction… . The object fell somewhere and disappeared. And it didn't show up again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Does that object have anything to do with time?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Tears of time... . This is the name of the item that God who forgave Sanak revealed to me.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I don’t know what power that object has or why Sanak took it… . I think you need that now.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: One day, Gaia said that there might come a time when the tears of time would be needed. So, I looked for a place where it might be located with the help of a spirit... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yeah. The spirit from Pneuma helped me. That's when I learned about the place called Freios Northwest Highlands.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Perhaps the tears of time are sleeping there. It's not exact, but I feel something like that in that area, so I'll have to look for it myself.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It might be a good idea to ask Arche, the manager of Pneuma, but right now I can't go to Pneuma or the place where Iris is, so I don't want to... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm sorry. I want to help, but there's only so much I can do in this situation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's okay.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: What if someone who is a descendant of a dragon takes on the form of a dragon? Is it similar to how I look now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a little different. Oh, let me draw it on paper for a moment. What does it look like... .
(Adkina looks at %s's dragon picture and is speechless for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Even if you draw Qiriling playing in the Valley of the Dragon, it's better than this... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's definitely not Pluton Dragon. Is it another dragon clan I don't know about? .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: In any case, the fact that the dragon's descendants used the time barrier means that the dragon's power has already been used in magic related to time.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: There seems to be no doubt that as Sanak touched it, that power spread to and could be used by beings such as dragons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know Sanak’s whereabouts?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I heard that the spirits were briefly seen somewhere in the Highlands, but then quickly disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see, Adkina, I'll go now.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: But will you be okay alone? There are probably people who feel the current situation and are moving... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Why not go with someone else? Ordinary people may not know this, but if you are a superhuman who solved the problem of Avalon together... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aren’t you all busy?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Everyone will be busy, but Baldrick will be fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick is sure to be busy too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina, I will go to Highland and look for the item you mentioned. Maybe if that's the case... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It will come back on time, or even this situation. You could go back to Iris... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You will be able to do everything well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. See you later then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Highland where the tears of time lie... You definitely said it was the northwest of Freios, right?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then, let’s ask Mr. Matthias in Luria Village where the Highlands are. It’s also west of Freios...)

steps.name: Road to Highland
steps.objective:
1. After talking to [Mathias] in 「Lulia Village」, go behind [Helena]'s house.
2. Meet [Trisha], talk to her, and use the village portal to go to the “Invernell Ruins Zone.” Then, report the quest to [Trisha] in the “Invernell Ruins Zone.”

lines.text: (Visiting Luria Village again, it still feels beautiful and peaceful, but the sight of the Atlas Garden in the distance seems foreign.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even though it looks like that, it's probably okay because no major problems have occurred... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What state is Iris now?... Whoa.)

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Why does a young person sigh like that? That's not enough to bring Freios down to the ground.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Mathias, the Continent of Freios must not fall!! ah… .

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Of course it shouldn't fall, but it won't fall. Just kidding, kidding.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was a little surprised.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I thought Mr. Mathias knew….)

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: You looked so bad that I thought you were in trouble. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to you, I feel better.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: What did I do? Anyway, I'm glad. Always let me know if you need help. I am the chief of this village, no. Because it's a representative.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Aside from that, I just want to help because I received a lot of help from %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? I never helped Mr. Mathias... .

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Jun, I mean Jun. Jun, who was busy playing with Heffling, started to listen well after meeting %s. How did you do it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .  I said I would tell Juen an interesting story.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Haha, I see. For some reason, I don't know when it will come, but I've been waiting less and less often to visit historical sites. Every day, I ask people, including Helena, if they haven’t seen %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something suddenly came up and I couldn't meet Jun. I don't think it will work now, could you please ask me to wait a little longer?

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Sure. Instead, I'd like to ask you to tell me an interesting story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Oh, that's right. Mr. Mathias. if… .

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Maybe?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know how to get to Highland?

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Highland? Are you talking about Invernell? Of course I know.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Highland is the name of the northwestern region, the highest point on the continent, and Invernell is the only town in the Highlands.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: There have been many legends since ancient times, and it was rumored that it was a place with sacred power. So, the religious order that followed God built a building.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: What a unique place. There are griffons, which are rare these days, and at one time, several forces fought to occupy them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It doesn't seem to be an ordinary area either.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: If you go straight out onto the main road behind Helena's house, you will see a road heading north. If you follow that road north, you can reach Highland.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: There happened to be a woman from Invernell who was looking for someone to go with her.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: About 10 years ago, demonic beasts and demons came in and parts of it became ruins, but I heard that it is still the same. It's dangerous to go alone... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go with you.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: I feel safe about you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is he now?

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: I'm looking for someone to go to in front of the main street. If you have someone to go with, would you please let me know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I'll go and talk to you. Mr. Mathias, thank you.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: What can you do with this much? Be careful on your way and take the woman with you. And come back later.
(Mathias lightly taps %s on the shoulder and enters the house.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Thanks to Mr. Mathias, I heard a lot about Highland.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (First, let’s go to the main road.)
What should I do? Should I just go?
I just need to somehow get to the ruins area. How did you come here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, is it that person?
(As Mathias said, a woman is seen in front of the main street behind Helena's house.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey there.
Yes?
(A woman with special henna patterns on her arms and forehead and impressive attire that cannot be easily seen takes a step back in surprise.)
What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard from the village leader that they are looking for someone to go to Invernell with them. Is that correct?
(The woman who was in tears a moment ago holds %s's hands with a bright smile.)
Yes, yes. that's right!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well then, would you like to come with me?
Okay. I had to go back, but it was too much for me to do alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said I had to go back... . Are you originally from Invernell?
Yes, I lost something, so I came all the way to Luria while looking for it. I never thought I would have to travel such a long distance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you find what you lost?
I found it and sent it back, but I wonder if it came back safely. Hehehe. Anyway, I finished one, so I have to go back.
That's right. My introduction is late.
(The woman shakes her head slightly, as if slightly embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: My name is Trisha. Please feel free to call me Trisha without any other title.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I was born and raised in Invernell, so I'm not used to seeing people from other regions, so it's a bit awkward.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. I'm also from a different place, so don't worry too much about it. I am %s… . Please feel free to call me by my name too.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Yes, %s. %s… ? I think I heard this name somewhere. Ah, the famous Adventurer that the priest was talking about… .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nice to meet you too. But I'm not just a famous person.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Hehe, you are humble.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason, just looking at him makes me feel good.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: By the way, %s, may I ask what you are going to Invernell for?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for something too. I don't know if I can find it... .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I see. I'm not sure what it is, but I'm sure I'll find it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Trisha, thank you. So when are you leaving? I want to go right away.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Gryphons don't hesitate when they want to fly, and that's exactly what it feels like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Gryphon…?)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Hehe, I was joking when I said it was a griffon. I know the way, so I will guide you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then I would like to ask you a favor. uh… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is it? I suddenly feel strange...)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha, I guess it's just my mood.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Ah… . That happens sometimes. Hehehe. Shall we go now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.
(Adventurer looks at the sky in the direction of Laran Road, but only the Atlas Garden is floating in the sky.)
(Shortly after Adventurer leaves Luria Village with Trisha, something large that appears to be carrying a boy appears in the direction of Atlas Garden.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What is that human? You probably didn't recognize me... ?
My time is not worth hiding from a little kid like you.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Who called you a kid? Drop it right now?
(The woman holding the magic golem Lycaria floating in the air with one arm sneers at Noname.)
Try as much as you want.
(A normal being would fall to the floor the moment she lowered her arms, but a woman would fly up gently like a butterfly regardless.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I knew that it wasn't an ordinary demon that the Archduke would ask for help, but... . Well, I'll praise you. Ugh, what, what?
(The woman reaches out and grabs Noname’s face and pulls it.)
How much of my convenience do you need to know?
(The long, pointed horn on the woman's forehead touches Noname's forehead. Then a single scream comes out of Noname's mouth.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Ugh, ugh… !!
I am not someone you should look down on because I have no name. If you don't want to get a hole in your head, be polite.
(Noname's vision gradually fills with red along with the pain.)
No, how about pretending?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Oh, okay… . Well, stop… . queen.
(The woman called Queen quietly steps back, apparently satisfied with Noname's answer. She then reaches out and strokes Noname's head.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Now you get it, right? You shouldn't be rude to the queen of the Gremory clan?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: That's how a child listens well. Hehehe. sorry. I ended up hurting you without even realizing it.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: My time will take away your hurt.
(With the Gremory Queen's words, an ominous green light flows from the fingertips and approaches Noname's wound.)
(Where the light created by the queen stayed and disappeared, there is no trace of the wound that occurred a moment ago. Not even the blood that flowed from the wound.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: This is the Queen's ability... .

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Isn't it too early to be this surprised?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Now, the little boy chases the human. I will inform the Archduke.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Okay. Please… .

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: See you later. I'll catch up with you soon.
(The Gremory Queen shows a bright smile and disappears on the spot.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Annoying… .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: They're all here. Based on this structure, the temple building visible to the north is Invernell.
(Trisha points to the white temple building standing tall on a rocky mountain in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Highland is a very large area. The place where you are standing now was also part of the village.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: The temple, residence, and land managed by the religious order are all part of Invernell, but now it is in ruins and there is nothing we can do about it.
(Where Trisha's eyes rested, flowers, trees, and weeds grew freely and tangled together with the broken structure.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: The atmosphere seems very different inside, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: This is called the ruins zone, and that is called the safe zone. It's the same Invernell, above the Highlands, but now it's divided into districts.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: At some point, demons, demons, and their demons appeared, and we were indiscriminately attacked and the building was destroyed.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: In the past 10 years, it has suffered serious damage and is almost in ruins, except for the northern part where the temple is located.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: In the end, I had no choice but to give up Invernell's class at the recommendation of the church and the order of the Emperor.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: So, it was divided into a safe zone and a ruined zone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did Trisha ask me to take her inside the ruins, saying it was such a dangerous place?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I had to come because of Gryphon work. And it's okay because there are people who always take me there.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Highlander Claire or Caluso Battle Priest. Part-time worker Romalius is helping me. You don't have to worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I understand Highlander and Battle Priest, but part-time job?)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Come this way, %s.
(While walking and having various conversations with Trisha, someone comes up next to %s and starts walking together.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … uh?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Don't be surprised. This is a kid I know.
(An animal with the body of a four-legged animal, the face of a bird, and agile wings is looking at Trisha with blushing cheeks.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gryphon?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Yes, it's a griffon. The village children also call it Guri-pong because it is difficult to pronounce. Then I thought they were Guri Pong too.
(The griffon pricks up its ears at the word Gurifong.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Gryphon… .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: That's right. It is an animal that is also known as a demonic beast to some people. Still, the griffons in this area are friendly with people.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Although this is a story limited to children who have been touched by humans. Hello, Salty?
(The gryphon next to her approaches Trisha and rubs her body as if she is okay.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: As a member of the Halein clan, I train and tame griffons as the representative. It's already been over 10 years.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Harlein clan and the Gryphon… . ah… . On the guild union side... .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Ahaha… . There were some griffons that went down to El Anor and caused quite a stir. How much trouble did you have to catch and solve it... .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I wish the guild union could clear up some misunderstandings, but it's not easy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see… .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: It's been a while since I've been doing this, but sometimes I have doubts.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Taming wild griffons is good for people, but I don't know if it's actually good for griffons.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Although it is a choice to be with many people, including my clan, it is not the right answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's difficult.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Right? So sometimes I wish there was a right answer. If there was a right answer, it would be Nirvana... .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I just talked about myself too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Then let's keep going.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Yes, this way.
(As Trisha enters the path seen between the broken structures, her movement slows down a little.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … uh?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Why are you doing this?
(The moment Trisha looks back, her slowed movements return to normal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's as if time has slowed down...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I felt like I stepped on something. It's a tree branch. Ahaha, it's my first time coming to this place so I guess I can't help but feel nervous.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Ah, I see. I was also very nervous when I went to Luria Village. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Now, come this way.

steps.name: Griffon's Howl
steps.objective: After talking to [Trisha] in the “Invernell Ruins,” kill [Insidious Kilesa] and [Angel Wing Nero]. Then return to [Trisha] and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Here it is.
(After walking for a while, at the place where the two people stopped, there is a structure with an old-fashioned feel, standing in a half-ruined state.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You have arrived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (again….)
(The moments where Trisha's movements slow down and then come back are repeated over and over again, as if there is noise in time.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This phenomenon has been going on since I came to Highland...)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: %s, I'll wait here for someone else and then we'll go in together. I have to write down my diary that has been overdue... .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: If you go all the way north, you can reach the safe area.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are all those items Trisha's?
(On one side, objects with patterns similar to Trisha's are placed in an organized manner.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: It's from the Harlein people. Originally, this was the area where the Hallai people lived.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: As many demons, beasts, and fierce animals appeared, most people left their hometowns. Only the few who did not leave remain in the safe zone.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I am taking care of the griffon in the ruins and organizing things little by little. It reminds me of when I was young, so... .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Actually, our house was in this place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. But you were taking care of a griffon here? Isn't it dangerous?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: That has some circumstances. uh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Trisha, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Can you hear me? Griffons are howling in the distance.
(The griffon that followed the group also raised its head and was about to howl, but when it made eye contact with Trisha, it closed its beak.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are paying attention, Salty.
(A griffon named Salty approaches Trisha with an expression that seems to want something.)
(While Trisha feeds the griffon with familiar skill, the griffon's cries echo throughout the ruins.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: In most cases, gryphons have never cried like that all at once... . What on earth is going on? Even though I cried along with Nirvana... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tricia, stay here for a moment. I will come and see.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Still, I have to see the gryphons... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way. No matter how well Trisha knows this place, it could be dangerous right now.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: … Yes, then promise me. I'll be back soon. I won't get caught up in anything bad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Trisha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please wait a moment with this guy. I'll come see you right away.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Yes, I will wait.

steps.name: Demon Romalius
steps.objective: After talking to [Trisha] in “Invernell Ruins,” defeat [Baby Iona] and [Happy Copperfong]. Then, report the quest to [Romalius] in the “Invernell Safe Zone.”

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: No, probably not. Nirvana is... . Ah.
(The moment Trisha turns around while looking towards the place where the crying sound is coming from, she collides with the approaching Adventurer.)
(The griffon quickly grabs Trisha's clothes and pulls her up when she almost falls with her beak.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Trisha, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I'm fine. Thanks, Salty.
(Trisha pets the griffon and takes out a snack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tricia, there was nothing to worry about. There were more griffons than when we came here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you look closely, it looks like they were sharing bread that someone had thrown at them.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Gryphons are not allowed to eat human food... . Phew.
(The griffon called Salty's eyes sparkle when he hears the word bread, but he becomes sullen when Trisha frowns.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what is nirvana? I think I heard it when I was leaving.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Nirvana is... This is a griffon that I grew up with since I was young. It was also the first griffon I tamed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. If I get a chance, I'd like to see it.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I'm not with you now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. You have crossed the rainbow bridge.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: That's not it... . 10 years ago, one day, I went to another area with my family and on the way back, we encountered demons and beasts.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Nirvana, who had been waiting, rescued the family and suddenly disappeared.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Even though it disappeared suddenly before, it would come back a few days later. But, it didn't come back.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: So, I have been searching and searching until now, but no one has seen Nirvana anywhere on the Continent of Freios.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: No one has ever seen a child three times bigger than the griffon here... .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Still, I think it's still alive somewhere. Because Nirvana is a smart and good child.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As Trisha said, I'm sure you'll be doing well.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I guess so?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Uh, Romalius? What happened so far... .
(Trisha looks on in surprise as someone appears behind %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, that… .
(A man with silver hair and red eyes makes light eye contact with Adventurer.)
(At that moment, the movements of not only Trisha but also the man standing in front of her slow down and then speed up again. This time, only Adventurer notices this.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Tricia, are you here with a guest? Nice to meet you. I am Romalius from Invernell... .
(As soon as Adventurer discovers the black horns on Romalius' head, he is surprised and raises his weapon. Trisha, who is next to him, grabs %s's wrist and stops him.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: %s, put down your weapons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? They're demons.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Romalius is a demon, but he converted.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Conversion? How can you believe that?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Demigod Lydia broke off her horn and made it impossible for her to use her magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Demigod Lydia?)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Trisha is right. Lydia broke my horn. If you still don't believe me, watch this.
(Romalius takes something out of his pocket and shows it to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Hwangseong’s… .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It's a temporary residence card certified by the Imperial Palace. I also received permission from the Church of Resedia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something is strange... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I have no intention of fighting with you. If you still don’t believe me, kill me right now. Because there won't be any resistance.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: %s, please clear up my misunderstanding now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s? Is that your name? Nice to meet you, maybe because I've heard it before.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: He said he defeated army commanders, a noisy crow, and an annoying incubus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Even though I didn't want to know, I kept hearing it.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Trisha probably doesn't know. How great that person is.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I know you're a strong person. Rather than that. Romalius, what brings you here?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I was working part-time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Part-time job?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I was chopping vegetables at the church cafeteria when Priest Caluso asked me to find out if there were any demons nearby since he would pay me double the hourly wage.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Even if I can't use my strength, I can almost feel it when demons appear. I guess they came from somewhere to do bad things again. It's an annoying instinct.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it some kind of radar? .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, that's a good phrase. I'm a surprisingly good radar, so I even let him know a few times.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aren’t they compatriots?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Because they are of the same race… . To the demons, their kin is meaningless. If you don't have the strength, they will try to kill you or keep you underfoot.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Although other races are similar, I think they are at least better than demons.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Romalius, this is going to end. Are you done exploring?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: The search is already over... . ah! I have to hurry up and get my next part-time job.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Romalius, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: When you return, please take this person with you to the village. I will go with Priest Caluso later when he passes away.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I'll treat you to some delicious food later.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, Trisha's food is absolutely welcome. It's perfect for my taste.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Trisha. I also looked for the griffon, but I couldn't see it very well. He was definitely the guy I cooked for... .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Really? It can't be helped. I have no choice but to find it again tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Now, %s. Follow Romalius.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay, Tricia?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: There is a priest Caluso nearby, so don’t worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the case... . See you later, Trisha.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I hope you find what you are looking for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Tricia.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I'm coming, Tricia. May happy times be with you in Nornir.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Romalius too. May happy times be with you in Nornir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this like a greeting from villagers?)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Now, %s. follow me Once you go, you will see how wonderful it is.

steps.name: Are there any suspicious rumors?
steps.objective: Talk to [Romalius] in the “Invernell Safe Zone” and listen to the stories of [Daniel] and [Eclair]. Then, wrap up the story near the village angel statue, and report the quest to [Alexis] in the “Invernell Safe Zone.”

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: That's the card certified by the emperor. i envy you.
(Romalius looks at %s's card with sparkling eyes.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I heard that if you have that, your status will be guaranteed and you can receive all the benefits of the empire.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so? Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: That means you are a great person. Recognized by the empire, and recognized by people like me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you at least for your words. By the way, the safe zone is definitely different from what you see in the ruined zone.
(A place that is a mixture of a temple building with strong castle-like walls and a solid feel, and a residence for people living mainly in the Highland region.)
(The safe area of Invernell where I set foot has a sacred and elegant feel, but is also full of life like any other town.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Right? Maybe it's because it was recommended by Demigod, but it's really nice.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: They say that 10 years ago, people lived all the way down there, so it was almost as big as a capital.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: So is it as big as Pandemonium?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's Pandemonium, then it's demons... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It's like my hometown, but it's a place of love and hate that I don't want to go back to. Stop telling such trivial stories.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s, what did you say you were looking for in Invernell? If someone like you came to Invernell... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It's probably not an ordinary item. Maybe it's similar to what the demons are looking for?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It's surprising. haha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe so.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Hmm… , I don't know what it is, but I hope you find it first. At least it will be put to better use in your hands rather than being taken by demons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You probably don't believe me... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Rather than believing in you, I just believe in the possibility of normal life excluding demons. At least, I think it is a more right choice to trust humans rather than demons.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: There's no need to think hard. Just recognize them as unique local residents, not enemies.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I'd like to show you around the village myself, but I have to go to work part-time, so I'll have to say goodbye.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Just look around town and find Alexis if you need anything. If Alexis doesn't want to work, show her the card.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Romalius.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: What do you do with that? Just as I am having the best and greatest time right now, may %s also have happy times in Nornir.
(Romalius laughs lightly and walks toward the direction of the temple building.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What a strange demon. Well, there are cases like Beled, so there could be demons like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The best and the best time... , for me, that would be finding the tears of time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's get some information from others. First of all, there didn't seem to be any unusual information from Romalius... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Even now, people's movements are slowing down and then coming back. This can't continue to repeat itself. Let's find a way quickly...)
(On the central street of the Invernell safe zone, an invisible being with the appearance of a normal resident is looking around with twinkling eyes.)
There certainly seems to be a lot of scoop here!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is it a prisoner?)
(It could be said that the creature looks like a large parrot, and appears to be wearing clothes that look like a specific occupation.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Reporter? Writer? I don’t think he’s a typical resident, so I’ll have to ask.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… .
(The large parrot holding the camera retreats in surprise at the voice calling it.)
Wow, what a surprise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… .
Do you have anything to report?
(The large parrot that just a moment ago added 'radish' to the end of every word is adjusting its monocle and pretending not to be surprised.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Report? no. I have something to ask.
Oh, do you need some information? If you read my article later... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you a reporter?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I, Daniel, a reporter chasing a scoop. If it's a scoop, I'll go anywhere, I'll go, I'll go!
(The parrot, who introduced himself as Daniel, looks happy and holds up the ID card around his neck.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you a prisoner?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: You saw it wrong. Oh, you shouldn't show it. Is it obvious? No, does it fly?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have no idea what you're talking about... . Are you sure you're not a prisoner?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Yes. My name is Daniel and I am from the monthly Rosengarten editorial department.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means they are demons.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Demons, yes.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh, how did you know!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you came from Rosengarten, the demon world, then of course you are a demon... .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Wait, how do you know Rosengarten?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: … … … Everything, you. That, that, that!! Ba, Ba, Baldrick who brutally beat down the dream demons?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I am %s… .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: %s? %s!! Wow. That, that, that!! The adventurer who is cruel to demons, but warm to goddesses. No, Adventurer!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Please save me! Just think of it as a talking parrot! I follow your words well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. all right. I will first listen to the story and then judge.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Thank you… . Mooooo… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Not one, but two demons are here. Daniel doesn't look that dangerous, but...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you get the scoop?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Phew, there is nothing… .
(Daniel sighs and looks at the distant mountains.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: There doesn't seem to be any scoop from Invernell, but we plan to cover it diligently.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Since there are demons and all kinds of people here, I think I can disguise myself as a parrot beastman from the next village!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Hehe, isn’t a scoop a reporter’s dream!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Your professional spirit is strong...)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Anyway, my reporting is not illegal. Demigod Lydia, a member of the Lesedia Church, helped us by saying she was an interesting demon.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: So that I can stay with permission from the village chief.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: And if a low-level demon does something bad, he casts a spell to destroy it on the spot. I'm not going to do anything bad, so it'll be okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is this person named Lydia?)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Hehe, I think it's cool that the reporter collapsed while covering the story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Can I ask the demon… Romalius said he didn’t know.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Isn’t information exchange the basis of reporting? I will tell you from the best of my knowledge.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel, didn’t you feel any strange force nearby? Are you a demon or something?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Well, it's okay. Hmm. I was a bit surprised to meet Romalius here, but other than that, there was nothing else.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Actually, since I am a low-level demon, I don't know much about great powers. ah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh? What is there?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: This is off the record, so it’s difficult to tell %s… .
Growling♬
(Daniel appears to be startled by the sound coming from his stomach and falls into a panic.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Ah, ah… . I couldn't eat anything when I came to Invernell. Romalius also said that demons who don't work shouldn't eat. Black and white.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll give you this. Will you tell me about it? This is beef jerky, a specialty from another continent... .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Thank you!
(Daniel snatches the beef jerky from %s's hand, puts it in his mouth, and begins to eat it.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: It's nothing special, it was a few days ago! I saw a witch going somewhere in front of me! I was looking for a place to hide!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Witch?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh, Hilda? If you're looking for a place to hide, then... Is there something here after all?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel, thank you. I think I'm hungry. Let's eat all of this. Good reporting. Don't do anything bad.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Thank you, but where does beef jerky come from like this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Also, people’s movements are slowing down. Let’s gather information quickly and move….)
When is your sister coming?
(A girl with hair color so rare that it catches people's attention is looking towards the village entrance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello.
(The girl is startled and steps back, tripping on something. %s is also surprised by this situation, but unconsciously reaches out and grabs the hand of the girl who is about to fall.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, that's a relief. are you okay?
It's okay, it's okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry if I surprised you.
Oh, no. I wasn't surprised.
(The girl stands up holding %s's hand and tries to act casually. But her face is full of surprise.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: My name is Eclair, you can call me Claire. and… .
(Eclair suddenly panics.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Claire?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: As I was thinking about how to introduce myself to someone I’m meeting for the first time… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Calm your mind and take a deep breath. And think peaceful thoughts. Then it will be okay.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Ah, yes… . Oh, I think it's going really well. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me introduce myself. I am %s… .

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I knew he wasn't an ordinary person, but I thought I knew it when I heard his name.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: There is Adventurer that is saving people from crisis. You're already the center of rumors in the empire... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's not that great of a person. But Claire, the thing you set up is a weapon, right?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Yes, this is a spiral sword, a weapon used only by the minority Highlanders who have protected the Highlands.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Since ancient times, strong weapons were needed to protect this place, and as they were made, they became this special.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Now, I'm a little worried because there are only a few left. However, we are not insisting on continuing only with a few elites.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Anyone who wants to become a warrior who follows the great land and sky is welcome. Even if it’s not necessary, if you want to protect something precious.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: So, I often help people who come to me with their training. I also wanted to practice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think Eclair looks strong too.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Oh, no. I still don't have much wealth.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Chi, thank you for the compliment.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: But… , what were you trying to ask?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you heard any suspicious rumors around Invernell recently? Or something strange happened.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: There are so many suspicious rumors and strange things that I don't know what to choose.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Don’t demons like Romalius come to town and work part-time? Isn’t the parrot beastman coming and reporting?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: … Oh, the griffons that were recently driven out disappeared from Invernell, so Trisha often went looking for them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Gryphons disappeared?)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Where is your sister now? ha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I already brought Trisha with me when I came here. I'm currently at a ruined house site.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Ah, thank goodness. Thank you, %s. Your sister is having a hard time too. Where have all the gryphons gone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm... something is strange...)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I'm worried about Tricia. There aren't many people left to take care of the griffons... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Claire, don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Do I look worried? I’m the type of person who hides my expressions well… .

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: What should I do… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to Claire, my curiosity has been resolved to some extent.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Thank goodness. I also won't worry because Trisha said she's in Invernell. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: If you have any further questions, please go to the village chief. Her name is Alexis, and she never leaves the area, so you'll find her quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Claire. I'll just take a look around the village some more.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Hello, %s. May happy times be with you in Nornir.
(Eclair walks away as if she has something to do.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nornir's happy hour seems to be a greeting used by the villagers. Seeing everyone say it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (People's movements are slowing down. Is this also an effect of time... Let's gather information quickly and move...)
(While moving around the Invernell safe zone, the movement of all visible beings slows down and then returns again and again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think something is wrong with the time force somewhere in Highland...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then let’s summarize for a moment….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The witch Daniel saw said that she was wandering around looking for a place to hide, and the village people, including Eclair, said that the griffons were disappearing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t know if this has anything to do with the tears of time. Phew….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm, Eclair told me to go ask the village chief, so I have to go.)

steps.name: ominous situation
steps.objective: Talk to [Alexis] in the “Invernell Safe Zone” and report the quest to [Trisha] in the “Invernell Ruins Zone.”

lines.text: (A young man with an atmosphere that does not fit in well with Invernell greets people approaching with a smile.)
(It lasts for a moment, and when the people leave, he leans against the wall, looking tired.)
Went… . ha… .
(The young man sees %s approaching and quietly turns his head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By any chance, Chief Alexis?
Yes? Ah, I answered it... .
(The young man who was standing listlessly a moment ago looks at the customer with a smile as if nothing had happened.)

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: My name is Alexis. It’s a bit ambiguous to call him the village chief, but… . By the way, how did you recognize me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Claire told me to go see Chief Alexis if I have any questions.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: This is the person the villagers were talking about. If you're coming to me, I guess you want to know something important.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: I heard that you are asking the villagers about suspicious rumors and strange things.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Please tell me your name and show me anything that can prove your identity.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes.
(Alexis receives the signed card from %s and looks surprised as she checks it.)

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: How do you get this precious card that even the nobles in the council can't easily get? .

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Your name is %s… . Ah, you are %s. I'm familiar with your name. I'm sorry I heard your father talk negatively... .

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: The nobles in parliament do not like those close to the imperial family. At least I am different from them, so please do not misunderstand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That means he comes from a noble family that belongs to the council...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Alexis. So are you from Glaston?

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Yes, there are circumstances. No, I was kicked out because I objected to what my father was doing because it was against the cause.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Why do you insist on doing something like that? . I can't tell you this because it's embarrassing. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Just thinking about it makes me feel tired and I want to rest... .

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Since I was kicked out, I tried to come to Invernell and have fun, but that didn't work out so I'm working so hard as the village chief!
(Alexis looks very tired.)

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Sorry. Stop talking to yourself... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It must have been very difficult.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: That's it, you still have to do your job. What brings you to Invernell?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for an item. I can't tell you what it is... .

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: It's okay. Because there are some things I can’t tell you. So, to the best of my knowledge, if I think about looking for suspicious rumors or strange things... .

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: There's nothing strange about it other than the demons working hard part-time or the parrot demons.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: What's unusual is that a Demigod has been visiting often recently?

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Recently, a lot of demons have appeared and we have come to exterminate them.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: I couldn't see it, so I talked to Priest Caluso and he said he caught a demon called Gremory that appeared in the ruins area.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Gremory clan? It makes sense that a demon that uses the power of time would come here, and that there would be tears of time here.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: I don't know where you've gone now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Alexis, thank you. It was helpful.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to meet Demigod Lydia later. Then I… .
(The moment I try to end the conversation with Alexis, the things I see move slowly again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh, again….)
(As the slowdown prolongs, a roar that sounds like an animal's cry fills the Invernell safety zone from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Time that had slowed down due to that sound returned to normal. What kind of animal cry is this?)

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: The gryphons are crying loudly again. It's been a while since I've been here, but I still feel like I need some time to get used to it. %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. That cry is a griffon?

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Yes, the sound is so loud that it looks like a Captain Griffon. Ah, according to the kids here, is it Guri Pong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Alexis, I'm going. Thank you for talking to me.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: No. I was very happy to hear that you were leaving.
(Alexis' tired face becomes brighter.)

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Haha… . If you need help with something else, please ask someone else rather than me. Most people in Invernell are friendly.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Then, may the happy times of Nornir be with you... . But why am I having such an unfortunate time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Uh, Claire?
(As Alexis stands blankly against the wall with a bright face, Eclair runs to where Adventurer is.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: %s, are you here? Did you just hear the griffon cry?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is that? What's wrong with a griffon crying like that... .

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: It's not a problem, that griffon cry, it's Nirvana.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute, Nirvana must have disappeared a long time ago... .

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I heard that sound and was about to go to the ruins, but Romalius left first, saying he would go with %s.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I need to quickly go to Trisha’s place. My sister will definitely be wandering around the ruins looking for Nirvana.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Claire. Then we hurry.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I know a shortcut. Please follow me.

steps.name: where the wind stays
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Trisha] in the 「Invernell Ruins Zone」, explore the 「Invernell Ruins Zone」 and enter the suspicious location.
2. If the ominous encounter in a suspicious location is over, quickly return to [Trisha] in the “Invernell Ruins” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Sister!
(Eclair sees Tricia always in the same spot and hurries away.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Claire? %s?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Good luck, sister.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Fortunately... . Thanks, Claire. You were worried because I hadn't seen you in a few days. Sorry, I went a little too far looking for Gryphon this time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay, Trisha?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. By the way, Claire. Why did you come out so early today?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I'm afraid that my sister will go to a dangerous place to find Nirvana... .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Nirvana? I almost gave up on finding Nirvana, why?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: No, that's not it. Didn't you hear?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: The sound of Nirvana crying.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Claire, what do you mean? The sound of Nirvana crying. Have you also heard of %s and %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An animal's cry was loud enough to shake the village.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Trisha, do you remember? Did you say that Nirvana's cry is different from that of a normal griffon?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Yeah, I remember. I studied a lot to tell the difference between crying sounds.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: There's no way that a sister like that wouldn't know Nirvana's cries that were loud enough to fill Invernell.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Was it that big? If it's that loud, there's no way I can't hear it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As if the safe zone and the ruined zone are in different time and space...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (My situation is not finalized right now, so it wouldn’t be surprising if something happened. Then….)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Sister, let's go back to the safe zone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just a moment.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You two don't know what's going to happen, so please wait here for a moment. I'll take a quick look at the ruins area.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Could it be dangerous?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I can't tell you that much. sorry.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Claire, %s let’s do as we say. It'll only take a moment, so let's wait here.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Okay, sister.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: %s, I'm here so there won't be any major problems.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: My Claire, I heard you are trustworthy.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: And thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I need to start looking somewhere other than the one I saw on the way up. I'm sure there's a strange place...)
(As Adventurer leaves, Eclair looks around.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: There's nothing strange here except for the little griffons wandering around. Tricia, are you… .
(Eclair stops talking to Trisha and looks forward.)
(A being moving powerfully with small wings is circling around Trisha.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: A cat with wings?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Sister, what is that?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Claire, let your guard down for a moment. I think this cat is trying to tell me something.
(As Trisha said, Eclair lowers the hand holding the spiral sword. Then a winged black cat sits on Gryphon Salty's head.)
(The black cat flails its front paws into the air as Trisha looks at her.)
Meow.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: It is said that the owner left his hometown and came here to avoid being captured by a witch, and that he met a demon here.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Thinking that they were coming to catch him, he ran away to a safe place that he had prepared in advance, but the moment he entered, the owner disappeared and he multiplied into several animals and gained wings.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Since my sister is a griffon trainer, I can understand griffon language. But the cat also understands... .
Meow.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: What's wrong, Tricia?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: They say the owner is trapped in moksha? What was Moksha... .

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Sister, wait a minute. Moksha is that. This is the story of the great priest that Priest Caluso told me.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: It is said that once upon a time, a priest was dragged by a mysterious force into a strange place somewhere in the Highlands, but was unable to find the exit and escaped after 10 years... .
(The wind that was gently blowing around the ruins stopped, and %s's steps, which were walking along the wind, also naturally stopped.)
(The broken structures of Invernell were visible throughout the passage, but they disappeared at some point and disappeared. Except for one.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it here? There is nothing… .
(At that moment, a large black shadow appears over %s's head. After a moment, something hanging from the black shadow falls to the floor.)
Boom.
(The boy, whose white ears perked up on top of his head, makes an unpleasant expression when he makes eye contact with Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What are you, coming out here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's what I want to say, but wait. You must be El-Larsa... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Yes, I was dead. By attacking that spirit guy. But the spirit touched the goddess and disappeared?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That’s… .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Don't you think it's hypocritical? God makes it because he needs it, makes it a lot of work, and gets rid of it because it's useless.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I have a feeling that one day it will destroy me like that. I guess not now though. It's amazing to see them keep alive like this.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: %s, what do you want to do? Shall we fight here? Anyway, here you are… .
(A mockery appears on Noname's face. Then, things in %s's field of vision begin to shake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: You'll find out soon enough, %s.
(Time slows down with Noname's words, and Noname, who seems to have recognized the situation at that moment, disappears before my eyes as if evaporating.)
(And an afterimage of another person appears in its place.)
(The moment time comes back, the blurry afterimage becomes clearer. Then, the figure of a being you don't really want to meet is revealed in front of you.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It's been a while, but looking at your expression, I guess the moment of our reunion was disappointing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
