lines.text: Isn’t this place really cool? It feels like time has stopped and even the wind has disappeared. In that sense, how about calling it a place where the wind stays?
(Barvatos adjusts his glasses and shows a characteristic sneer. He then passes by the wary %s.)
(The moment Adventurer tries to raise the weapon, the colder and sharper metal than ever before approaches his throat.)
(And then a woman's voice as cold as a knife is heard.)
You are a man of the Holy Spirit.
As a cooperator with the Archduke, I believe what he says, but this time I was a little suspicious.
But I never thought you would show up. Hehehe.
(A woman with horns on her forehead shows a dry smile that matches her pale skin.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you? If you see him with the Archduke, he's definitely a demon... .
As the Archduke said, it is rude. You call me, the queen of the Gremory clan, “you”… .
(The woman sighs and withdraws the side from %s's neck. Adventurer hastily raises her weapon and takes a guard stance again.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: This is the queen of the noble Gremory clan.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: If you want to call me Queen, call me Queen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gremory Queen… , of the clan that appeared in the sanctuary… .

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: The children who were like family fell to you. So one day, I want to take your life in my hands and shake it... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Queen.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I know, Archduke.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hurry up and tell me what you're here for.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: It's too noisy for a human subject. Now that we've told you that, what do you think you can do?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I just slightly shook up the time here, but if you show up here, it means your time is wrong.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: If you see that I don't deny it... . By the way, Grand Duke.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Say something, Quinn.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Please allow me to dispose of this human being.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It is not too late even after you have obtained the tears of time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…Tears of Time!! It’s here.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I know what you mean, Grand Duke. I will give the person of the Holy Spirit some time.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Still, it must be a meaningless time. There will be very little you can do in a mess of time.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Queen, wouldn’t it be better to have a little fun?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: %s, since you are here. You don't have a choice. In that sense... .
(Barvatos throws a silver coin into the air that I don't know when he prepared. The moment the silver coin enters his hand, %s's vision shakes.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Still, you're lucky. Depending on how you endure this ordeal, you will have time to save your life.
(The Gremory Queen and Barbatos, who were mocking in front, are obscured by dark shadows.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Queen, have you found the entrance to Moksha?
(Barvatos' voice is heard in the darkness.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Of course, Archduke. I found a structure that looked like a door.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: After all, queen.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Grand Duke, I appreciate the compliment, but it is natural for the Gremory clan to look for treasure.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What are these demons? Can’t you see me?)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Where is the inquiry located?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: There are humans on one side of the ruins, and there will be a place nearby where griffons are concentrated. It's there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…near where Trisha is?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What are they saying next? I can’t hear you….)
(I try to listen and focus on the conversation between the two demons, but I can't hear anything, as if everything around them has been engulfed by something.)
(After a while, light approaches %s's vision, which had been unable to see anything.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is this situation? There are no demons. Wait, where was I all this time? It must be there.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to your senses, %s….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There must have been a tear of time in a place called Moksha, so the two demons went there... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go quickly, we have to hurry.
(Adventurer hurries back behind the stone structure and escapes to the original ruins.)
(The wind that had stopped blowing over the sky at the place where Adventurer disappeared. And a huge being that was hidden somewhere and was not visible appears.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: This is the reason for delaying disposal. That's interesting.
(The Gremory Queen, who was floating in the air with Madogole Likaria, smiles at Noname.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Quinn, is this an anti-aircraft plan?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: That's right. They say that there is someone else who seeks the tears of time, so it would be better to confine them to Moksha.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Is it a place called Moksha, once you enter you can never get out?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Even the leader of Agashura, who is said to be able to fly, cannot handle whether he will be able to come out once he enters. Does this explain it?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: If even the head of Agashura... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Quinn, I found the door.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Well done, Noname. The Archduke is right.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Noname can find the door to the realm of the gods... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Is that why you came to see me?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I don't know what you mean. Please resolve what happened between Noname and the Grand Duke on your own… .

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Hehe, what happens inside Nornir's tears is left to me. The little boy won't be able to go in anyway.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: A space that only those who can use time can enter, the Tears of Nornir... .
(The Gremory Queen smiles with her eyes closed.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I'm really looking forward to it.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Quinn, follow me. I will tell you where the gate to Nornir's Tears is.

steps.name: cat's owner
steps.objective: Talk to [Trisha] in 「Invernell Ruins Zone」, enter 「Moksha」 and kill [Repika]. Then return to [Trisha] and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Sister, the cat that was here just disappeared, right? W, here… .

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Uh, sister. Chi, you need to calm down. therefore… … .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Claire, come to your senses.
(Trisha holds Eclair's panicked hand and shakes it.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I guess I still lack training. Be surprised by something like this... .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Could it be that the disappearance of the cat has something to do with %s coming over there?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Well… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Trisha! Claire! Nothing special, right?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: %s, nothing special happened... .

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: A cat with wings flew in, isn't that a big deal? Tricia even understood what the cat was saying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you say?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: The owner said he was trapped in moksha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Trisha, do you know where Moksha is?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: No one knows about Moksha because it is a place in Highland legend.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I do? That’s right. A place where griffons are concentrated….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Trisha, is there a place nearby where griffons gather?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: There is. Would you like to come with me? Right down there… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Trisha stay here.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Tricia, I'll go there with %s. Hide here. If anything happens, I'll come right here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Trisha, you'd better do as Claire says.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Hey, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: What is happening in the ruins?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: The cry of my disappeared griffon could not be heard here, but it could be heard in the village... .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: A cat with wings came and talked to me... .
(Trisha looks at Adventurer with anxious eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know for sure, so I can't say anything.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Trisha, I think %s is recognizing that now too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Because I couldn’t tell you everything….)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: No, I'm more sorry. I asked without thinking like I was complaining... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Instead, I promise. Don't get caught up in anything bad, no. I won't let anything bad happen.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Thank you, %s. I'm sure everything will be fine.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: %s, that's where the griffons are concentrated. Please follow me. I'll be right back, sister.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Yeah… . Everyone be careful.
(The gryphons, who were busy resting, quietly raise their heads and look ahead. They show interest when Eclair takes out a snack prepared in advance and shakes it.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Good boy, guys. I'm sorry I'm not Tricia.
(When Eclair throws the snack in the opposite direction with all her might, the griffons follow and fly away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's amazing, Claire. The snack I threw will fly all the way to Luria... .
(Eclair's face heats up, probably from embarrassment.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Chi, thank you for the compliment. Still, not to that extent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This angel statue here. I think I've seen this often since I came here... .

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: This is a statue of an angel that is commonly seen in Invernell. There was a saying that it was so elaborately made that it was actually made by an angel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like all the other angel statues have fallen down, but this one is standing upright? The posture is different, the size is different... .
(At that moment, the movement of the eclair passing by %s slows down and then returns.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (They say the Gremory Queen is nearby... Where is it? Is it behind this angel statue?)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: The angel statue was made by the religious order while building a temple... . %s?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Where have you been? %s!!
(Eclair looks around as %s, who was listening to the angel statue next to her a little while ago, suddenly disappears.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: %s, where have you gone? %s?
(The only things still visible are the praying angel statue and the griffon flying in to rest here.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: No way… Is this what %s was worried about?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I need to contact Father Caluso quickly... . Oh, that's right. I have to go to my sister first.
(When Eclair hurries back to where she came from, someone who was watching her from somewhere quietly appears.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Never thought Moksha would accept you so easily... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You are not suited for this world, so please do not come out after being trapped in Moksha for a long time... .
(I just walked behind the angel statue, and the ruins, with only the remains of the broken building and statue, disappeared completely.)
(And only thick fog and stone blocks with strange patterns engraved on them greet visitors entering the new world.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This doesn't make sense.
(Blocks that seem to fill a part of a nonsensical world move as if writhing.)
(It even feels like some of the blocks floating in the air are about to fly off somewhere at any moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where on earth is this? Obviously I... . Ah, really Moksha?
Boom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh. What, what?
(Every time the huge shadow seen on the hill takes a step, everything in sight shakes. Then, the stacked blocks break or scatter and rise into the sky.)
Boom.
(I try to avoid the unknown being and go to the place I came from, but there is hardly a path in sight.)
(There were only blocks with strange symbols on them scattered here and there, creating different paths.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I get from here? Are the tears of time here? huh?
(At that time, I felt like my collar got caught somewhere, so I turned around and saw someone standing there.)
(A girl wearing a hat that looks like cat ears and holding the handle of a large suitcase with a cat on it bows as if saluting.)
Hello, hello.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who?
I'm Lepika.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing here? Here… .

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Are you trapped too?
(The girl who introduced herself as Lepika sighs. She then takes out a potion from the bag on her waist and hands it to %s.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Do you want to drink this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Lepica's Alien Red is not only good for digestion, but also fills you up even when you're hungry.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: This is really good. Or should I give you something else? How about Freeling Green? now. Don't decline.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The potion names are Alien Red, Freeling Green... . Why is everything like that?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: But who are you? Who came in here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My name is %s, and I heard there's something here... .

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: %s, %s? I think I've heard your name before... . Let’s just talk comfortably.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Anyway, %s, there are no tears of time here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … How do you know that?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I spent a week looking for a place to escape the monster's eyes. If there was such a thing as tears of time, I would have seen them in my eyes.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Oh, you can't get caught by a monster. There was a woman who came after me. I was grabbed by the monster and turned into dust.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I just needed a safe place... .

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: This isn't the safe place I thought it would be.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A safe place? Why were you being chased?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: To the witch... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means you too are a witch... .

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: No, I'm an ordinary elf... . Oh, really!
(At that moment, Lepika steps back in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I'm not the bad witch people think!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Refika, I didn't come here to harm the witch.
(Lepika picks up her travel bag with both hands and swings it vigorously. No matter how hard she tries to stop her, she shows no signs of calming down.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: They all died before my eyes just because they were witches... . They were just special people! And I didn't want to be a witch either... .

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Why is there a black moon on my comfortable night? .

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Haha… .
(Repika sighs and puts her bag on the floor again.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I'm sorry. ah… . Now I remember. I said I thought I heard your name somewhere. Hilda said that.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: %s I will help you when I meet you. He said that God would help him because he is someone he cares about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know Hilda? Where is Hilda now?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Yeah. Hilda is my friend. He came to me one day and said he needed a place to hide. And he told me that the night had begun.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I didn't see him for a while and then he told me to find a hiding place and run away... . I actually don’t know where Hilda is right now.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I told you to come again when you want to see Nero... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nero?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: This is the familiar cat I raise. But where did it go? Nero, Nero!!
(When Lepika calls someone's name, a lot of winged cats fly from all over Moksha's sky.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Argh! Come one by one! Don’t let dozens of them come at once! Why did it split into dozens as soon as it entered here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A cat with wings? It looks like the cat Trisha was talking about...)
(The cat called Nero pays no heed and approaches Lepika and starts rubbing its entire body. And that's not just one, but dozens of cats.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Nero, you idiot! I haven’t even taken my allergy medication today!!

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Pew, pew!
(With Lepika's sneeze, the startled cats rise into the air as if running away. However, the persistent cats crawl into Lepika's arms once more.)
Meow!

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Argh, Nero! What are you doing? Have somewhere to go? You can't do it here?
Meow! Meow!
(Dozens of Nero grab Lepika and fly into the air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nero? Nero! Where are you taking Lepika?!
Meow! Meow! Meow!
(The meow, meow sound is so loud that it fills the moksha.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: %s, Nero found a way to get out of Moksha. He said he found something I couldn't find even after wandering around for a week.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do... ?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Pew! Hingfu!

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: … This damn allergy. Phew, not here. Wait, listen to Nero’s story. uh? Should I do that?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Hey there, %s. After listening to the method, I think it’s okay. I made a plan right away... .

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Even if Nero bothers you a little, don't get angry and just be patient.
(Then dozens of Nero fly in and block %s's view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what? It's okay to approach, but don't get any hair in your mouth... . uh?
(When the cats that blocked the view flew up again and disappeared, Lepica, who had been captured by Nero in the air, was no longer visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Repica? Repica? Where did you go? Nero, where did you take Lepika? Argh!
(At that moment, many Neros fly in to attack as if they had promised each other.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this what Nero was telling us to endure even if it bothered him? . Is there a way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't help it. I have no choice but to trust Lepika. Let's go first. If you go, something will work out.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: You've made it this far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha, haha. Can I take a break?
(Lepika looks at %s's exhausted state and looks sad.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: It must be difficult. But there is no time to rest, so what should I do?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: This may seem like a ridiculous method, but I don't think it will work if you rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What about Nero?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Yes, Nero heard it from a friend he met outside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Friends?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: When Nero entered Moksha and split, he gained special abilities. Even though I was here, he went to Moksha and came in and out regardless.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: So, to find a way, he met people and animal friends.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, so that’s why he appeared in front of Trisha. By the way, animal friend?)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I asked the Gryphon leader how to get out of Moksha, and he said that you have to release a huge amount of energy, whatever force you have, to shake Moksha.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Moreover, you have to throw away all greed and useless thoughts. Why is there such a method? Phew… .

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: So I tried to do it on my own safely here, but it doesn't seem to work either.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Just in case, I made another plan, and you were in that plan too. I told you not to get angry and to hold back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I did.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Right now, other than the monster you see over there, you and I are the only ones who have the power to shake this place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. Repika. So what should we do?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I hate it, but let's put all those thoughts aside and just think about getting out.
(Repika takes out various potions from her bag and puts them between her fingers.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Repica?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: We must collide our forces with yours to shake Moksha. Even if it's an unwanted fight. It's so unfair to be stuck here forever and not be able to do what you want.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Now we have to do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the only way, there's nothing you can do. I will do it. I'll try it.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Trust me. Because I am confident in my skills. Then let's go!
(With those words, all kinds of potion caps fly up into the sky of Moksha.)
(Repika puts her hand into the bag and stirs it around. Surprised, she opens it and finds that only two potions remain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Refika, we don't have time. You have to do it quickly. The monster approaches faster.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: … okay. But what should I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I don't have many potions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Refika, don't worry. We did our best so everything will be fine... .

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Yes, I will believe in this moment because you believed in me as much as I believed in you.
(The monster's appearance gets closer and closer, and the moment it stands in front of the two people, the monster raises its arms and takes a stance to hit the ground.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Then we go again!
(The moment the potion bottle is opened, the loud cry of a griffon heard in the village is heard from somewhere.)
(However, regardless of that, %s's attack collides with the flowing potion solution containing strong magical power.)
Ku-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa!
(The purple potion solution reacts to the strong force and rises into the sky with a loud sound. It then explodes like a firecracker, filling the entire Moksha.)
(And little by little, the fog visible in the distance is erased.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Oh, that's ridiculous. %s, see there? Can you see it?

(As the fog clears, the sight of the monster approaching the place where the two people were becomes blurred. And through it, the original appearance of the ruins begins to be revealed little by little.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Did you do it?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Don’t you know that you shouldn’t say something like that in a situation like this? If you say things like that, they might come back... … … … .
(With those words, the monster that had truly disappeared somehow begins to move again.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: What should I do?
Meow!

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Nero, I used up all the potions... .
Meow!
(Lepica is dazed and then gets hit on the head by Nero's paw.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Ah, it hurts!! Are you going to keep calling me an incompetent witch? Shut up and listen to me? How do I get out?
(As soon as he finished speaking, dozens of Nero came over and grabbed the two people, pulling them up into the sky.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Pew! Hehehe! Nero, really!
Meow!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh. Nero?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: The fog is blooming again!! Hold on tight!
Meow! Nyaaaaaaa!
(With an angry cat cry, the group flies through the fog of Moksha toward the sky that appears to be a ruined area.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Efew! Hehehe!!

steps.name: The place indicated by the crying sound
steps.objective: Talk to [Trisha] in the “Invernell Ruins Zone” and report the quest to [Caluso] in the “Invernell Ruins Zone.”

lines.text: (Nothing is heard, nothing is seen, and no part of the body moves.)
(The mind is alive, but it seems to be unable to wake up properly. At that time, a strange sound is heard from somewhere that shakes the mind.)
Efew! Hehehe!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This sound... By the way, what's on my face? Why is it so heavy? What happened to me now?)
Nero, you're not sitting on people's faces.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nero? Oh, it’s Repica’s voice.)
(The moment you reach out and grab something from your face, the world where you couldn't see anything begins to regain its light little by little.)
Meow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you out of your mind?
Nyang♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Nero. You've been sitting on my face... .
(While lifting Nero and pushing him to the side, three girls are seen looking at Adventurer who was lying down.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I got fur in my mouth.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: %s, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Trisha, %s looks fine. He also talks to cats.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: It was the same for me too. Nero, %s I'm out of my mind, so would you like to come here?
(Nero makes eye contact with Trisha and then flies into her arms.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Nero, don't forget that you are my familiar. But the wings don't disappear... .

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Nero, should I take your wings off? Ah, if you like the wings, you like them. Why are you hitting the owner?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Refika, were you really in Moksha?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Yes, thanks to %s, I was able to come out with Nero.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I thought it was a story from a legend, but it turned out to be a real place.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Claire, the world is full of unbelievable things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Looks like the three of you have already said hello. We all know each other's names. Ah, but why was I lying here?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: It fell from the sky.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Suddenly Nero becomes one. They seemed to be unable to bear our weight and just let go. He seems like a heartless guy.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Ahaha… , So that’s why you fainted… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… , it's time to get used to it, but it doesn't work that way.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: What on earth do you do... .
(At that moment, a griffon's cry loud enough to fill the ruins of Invernell is heard.
(Trisha, startled, almost drops Nero, who she was holding without realizing it. Fortunately, Nero flaps his wings and flies away.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: … Nirvana? This is Nirvana. He cried like this when he called me.
(Tears form in the corners of Trisha's eyes as she calls out the name of the person she misses. Nero, watching, quietly licks the corners of Trisha's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Nero, isn’t that Captain Gryphon?
Meow, meow, meow. Meow.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: What is Nero saying?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: The door to the Tears of Nornir has been opened, the man of the Astral God must come quickly... ?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Trisha returns home with Claire... ? Nirvana, right? Nirvana... .

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Captain Gryphon's name is Nirvana.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I couldn't believe it... . It's strange that now Trisha can hear me crying.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: It's as if time and space are at odds.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: %s, is that why you came here? I think what you're looking for is over there. I see Nirvana looking for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess so.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I'll go with Nero now.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Just want to go?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I just barely said hello... .

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: The two returned to the village as Nirvana said. It will be dangerous to stay here. Because it seems like unexpected things are happening.
Meow.
(Nero draws a large circle with his front paw.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Thanks, Nero.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: … I still don't know. But that doesn't mean I can stay here like this. I'll go first and find a way to protect the village.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: The village will be fine. Nero says that they will leave here as soon as they get what they want... .

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Hmm… . Well then, that's a relief... .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Claire, let’s go back. For now, we have no choice but to wait in the village and wait.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Okay, sister.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Repika, where are you going?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: A place without witches. I don't know where that is, but it must be somewhere safe. But I can't just hide here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know of one safe place.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Is there a place like that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There will be a goddess statue at the gates of Sanctuary Eidos. In front of him, say that you are Hilda's friend, that you were introduced by %s, and that you are looking for a safe place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we will go to the safe place where Hilda was.
(Lepika's eyes sparkle and she looks satisfied.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Since I received your help, I will repay you double someday.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Uh, does this mean…?)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Bye then, bye everyone. We'll meet again later. When I'm safe, I'll go play with Nero in the real Invernell safe zone.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Yes, Repika. May happy times be with you in Nornir.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Be careful. I hope you are safe. Really coming to have fun... . May Lefika and Nornir have happy times together.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Ugh, I… . This is the first time someone wishes me happiness like this... . I like Nornir too. May Nornir be happy. yes.
(When Lepika whimpers, Nero jumps up and kicks her with his back foot.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Nero, come to your senses and stop teasing the owner.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Well then, take care everyone. And %s, you too, get your work done without much trouble. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, bye.
(Lepika stretches and smiles brightly. Then, she takes out the remaining pink potion from her bag and sprinkles it on the floor.)
(After a while, a gate-like structure seen at the Nereis Gateway rises where the potion was sprayed.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I'm glad I have this potion left. Then really hello, hello!
(Lepika salutes instead of saying hello and hurries to enter the gate with Nero. The moment Lepika enters, the gate disappears without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Seeing as she has amazing abilities that aren't magic, is Lepika that kind of person? .

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Shh.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Yes, sister. I know.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: %s, I'll be waiting for you back in the village with Claire. You said it wouldn't be a bad thing, so please do that.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: %s, if you have a chance later, please tell me about the situation. It's a little frustrating now, though.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Priest Caluso will always be patrolling over there during this time. You said you often feel a faint sense of divine power over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Tricia, Claire. Then me too... . May you two have happy times in Nornir together... .
(Eclair and Tricia respond with bright smiles to %s's greeting wishing them happiness. Then they quickly leave for the village.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I have to do my job too. I definitely said it was over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go to the place where the tears of time lie.

steps.name: yesterday, today, and tomorrow
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Caluso] in the “Invernell Ruins” and enter “Nornir’s Tears”.
2. Defeat [Gremory Queen] in “Tears of Nornir” and obtain the <Key to the Other Side>.  Then, return to [Caluso] in “Invernell Ruins” and report the quest.

lines.text: (A man wearing a neat priest's uniform, but looking somewhat delinquent is scratching his chin and looking around.)
Romalius is clearly nearby, as he stopped doing his part-time job and ran over, but I can't see anything.
Romalius, I wish you could focus more. I will charge you separately to the church for your hard work. Oh, please understand if it takes a while.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Thank you, Father Caluso.
(Caluso pulls his mustache and laughs lightly.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: You can't treat talented people without pay. Hehe, it's okay since it's not my money anyway.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Priest Caluso, you look truly scary.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I don't want to hear things like that from demons. Stop talking nonsense, did you feel anything?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: … It's faint, but I can feel a tremendous amount of magic over there. I don't think they are ordinary demons... .

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Is it related to %s’s arrival?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: You can't say it doesn't exist. Griffon said he would come if I told him, and that person over there is coming.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: By the way, Romal. Where did you learn that? There is no such word in Highland... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s, welcome.
(Romalius sees %s approaching and gestures.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius. Were you here? Is the person next to you priest Caluso?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Are you %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He is a scary looking person….)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: As the highest priest of Lesedia, I have a request to make. Do you have anything to prove your identity?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: This is my original impression, so please do not misunderstand. Sometimes, there are people who see me as a scary person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… .
(Caluso looks at the imperial authentication card in %s's hand and is impressed.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: %s recognized by the Hwangseong and the church… . Confirmed. I am the highest priest of the Church of Resedia, also known as Caluso and the Church of Ceres.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I'm a little embarrassed to introduce it with my own words as the best. haha. He is currently an incompetent priest who is not the best.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I lost too much divine power in the battle with the demons. It was because I lacked ability.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Haha, it's not like it hurts or is hard or anything like that. However, it's a shame that you can't participate in large-scale battles.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Mad Battle Priest Caluso is now a thing of the past... .

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Oh, it was a long, useless story. So shall we get straight to the point?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Would you mind thinking that I am helping %s with Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . I don't think it's very different.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Okay.
(At that time, the movements of Caluso and Romalius in front of me slowed down and then returned again. And this repeated several more times.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Has time been warped? .

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Romalius felt it too. How about %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You two felt something too. As of now, the time is... .

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: You can explain later.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: … This energy... .
(Romalius seems to have felt something and walks forward quietly.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Romalius, there is nothing in front of him.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Both of you, come here for a moment.
(As we approach the place Romalius called, there is a stone gate similar to the entrance to Moksha.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: These are stone gates that were erected here and there in Invernell by the church a long time ago. But, it's definitely different here.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: But what is this… ?
(Caluso finds something that fell in front of the door and takes it in his hand.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: It's a black piece that looks like a butterfly... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Similar to the Archduke's, but no. If it is the strong scent of greed... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: The Gremory Queen is here. She is a woman who helped the Archduke with his work in the Demon World.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Wait, when you say Archduke you mean Barbatos? Besides, why is the Gremory Queen here…? .

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: It doesn't make sense if you know the Gremory clan's abilities. No way, the reason %s came here... .

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: To enter the realm of time... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Does Priest Caluso know these two?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I know. I don't know about the Queen of the Gremory Clan, but I don't know about the Grand Duke... .

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: One day, when the Pope came here with refugees during a war, he encountered an unfamiliar place.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: And I don't know what happened there, but it is said that he came out and sealed the place.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I think this is probably the place where the power of the demons can be felt right now. Is that okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something that needs to be resolved.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Okay. Let me just check one thing. Have you felt the passage of time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Just like the two of you felt, I felt as if time had been distorted.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: If the Gremory Queen entered here, there must be a divine treasure related to time.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I think it's the Duke who needs the treasure, but I'm sure the Queen will make it hers the moment she sees it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Queens are like that from the beginning. Even the Archduke doesn't know that.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: So, did you knowingly let them go inside to find the treasure?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Father Caluso, I'll have to go and check that out. First of all, it's just my prediction.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: It was as expected and fits very well. He is also a great talent. I need to ask the church to raise my hourly wage.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Thank you, priest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Queen is that dangerous, we shouldn't be delaying here.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: %s. Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: The reason the old Pope passed away not long after coming out of the realm of time was because he was affected by the warped time.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: So, he left a prayer for the great man who will one day enter the world.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: As the highest priest of the Lesedia Church, I will recite the prayer. I never thought I would meet someone who will enter Nornir's tears... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Nornir's tears... , what a cool name. But what is Nornir?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: It is a general name for the gods who share the past, present, and future.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Father Caluso.
(Caluso quietly closes his eyes and places his hand on %s's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Time of Nornir. Nornir of time. Day and night, sun and moon, yesterday, today, and tomorrow. I hope the time you have is happy.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: And… .
(An unknown light blooms in front of Caluso as he continues to pray.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Priest Caluso. It seems Nornir has responded.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Huh?
(When Caluso opens his eyes and looks ahead, a curtain like a magic gate is spread out in front of the door.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Who is %s?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: The light came and took him away as if it was pulling him from within.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I wish that light was Nornir. I want to help, but we're not even allowed to go in like this.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: … Let's wait here for now. The Archduke might be watching here from somewhere.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: It's not a big deal to see it like this again, hehe. First, I need to send a message to see if Lydia is nearby.
(As Caluso's prayer continues, the sudden cry of a griffon shakes the ruins.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh. I fall like this... … .
Boom!
(%s was not the only one shaken. The sharp side of the malicious one fell to the ground, aimless.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … … Gremory Queen.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Oh my.
(The Gremory Queen deliberately pretends to be surprised and looks at Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: As the Archduke said, you are lucky. Death must have been right around the corner, so it's amazing that he got out of the way like this.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: As if I entrusted my life to that griffon... .

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: That gryphon... . Hehehe.
(The Gremory Queen smiles lightly as if she knew something. Then, she lightly picks up the fallen side.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: %s, look where you stand.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: The tears shed by the gods, and the realm of time where those tears are buried. This is the place where you and I have what we're looking for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nornir's tears?
(When I look around, I can't see Caluso and Romalius, who were in front just a moment ago. I can't even see the ruins of Invernell Temple in the distance.)
(In the center of a large temple, a suspicious object is trapped in a metal orbit filled with light and is moving little by little. Its appearance is reminiscent of the gears of a clock.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (When did I come here...? No. It is the same here as if I entered Moksha.)
(The Gremory Queen sneers at %s's actions as she looks around in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Still don't understand the situation? Looking at him flustered, he doesn't seem to need to be careful at all, so why is he like that? Phew.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Look at me, %s. Let's make a bet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bet?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Find treasure within the vast tears of Nornir. Whoever finds the treasure first takes their life.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Before that, I'm going to get rid of that senseless gryphon first.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: How do you feel?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: %s, do you think I'm asking your opinion?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that was the demon's way. You're going to do whatever you want anyway. Like the Archduke.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: What should I say about this complex and delicate feeling compared to the Archduke? Hehehe. Especially forgiveness... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't be mistaken. Gremory Queen.
(The Gremory Queen's face was distorted for a moment, but it returned to its original state as if it had never happened.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I don't know who is mistaken, %s.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Disrespect your life. The moment I find the treasure, I will reap it myself. Right on the spot... . And before that, from that disturbing griffon… .
(As the Gremory Queen shows an eerie smile, everything around her stops moving.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Queen!!
(Adventurer approaches to move, but the Queen that was in front of her just a moment ago does not appear to have evaporated.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's late. Phew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It is clear that he is as formidable an opponent as the Archduke. I can't help it. I have no choice but to find the tears of time faster than the queen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … uh?
(A large shadow falls over %s as he steps forward to enter the Tears of Nornir.)
(A large being that has stopped flapping its powerful wings stares at Adventurer in an upright posture.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s Nirvana, right?
(An honest and brave being, different from the regular griffons seen in the Highlands, nods its head quietly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You understand what I'm saying.
「Come to your senses, %s!!」
(Someone's voice is heard in %s's head along with the griffon's loud cry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what? This is like Adkina’s saying… .

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “Do not doubt, but look at me. The griffon that Trisha named Nirvana... .」
(Nirvana makes eye contact with Adventurer and tries to approach, but collapses.)

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “Ugh… .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “That’s not important now. %s. I should have saved you more than myself. “You have already failed to find the Tears of Time before the Gremory Queen several times.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. What is that... .

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “From the moment you entered Highland, you experienced death several times and woke up again.”

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “Yes, you won’t believe it… . You won't believe it. But, I had to.”

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “Because protecting this place is protecting Trisha. Because that is the way to atone. “I had to help you.”

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “To turn back time here so that you can rise again.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… . It felt like time had slowed down... .

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “The twisted shaking of time you felt were the moments when you returned from death and started over.”

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “Ugh… .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana!

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: 「… Me, I'm fine. So keep listening to me. If you don't get the Tear of Time, the Gremory Queen will go beyond the demons... .」

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “I will become a demon god. “That was the last future I saw before I turned back time.”

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “This is your last time with me. “I don’t have time anymore.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does that mean... .

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “What you guess is correct. “I used up almost all the time I had by turning back time.”

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: 「… If the last remaining time were to disappear, I might turn into a magical beast with only instinct left and interfere with you.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana... .

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “Hurry up. %s. Iris Protect you, Trisha, and everyone. In all our times and moments… .」

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: 「… If the worst comes, ▒▒ of ▒▒ falls away from ▒▒▒▒. … … … … … … .」
(With those words, Nirvana takes off again with difficulty. However, it does not last long and falls somewhere.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana?! nirvana!!
(He rushes forward, but Nirvana is nowhere to be seen.)
(The beings who were wandering around the realm of time due to the commotion a moment ago slowly come to the front of %s.)
(Beings and spirits that embody time, and even the clone of Nero, Repica's familiar cat, who does not fit in here. Everyone just pays attention to the movements of the uninvited guest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if you look at it that way, there is nothing you can do about it. I have to survive somehow to see the end of this time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So don't disturb my remaining time!!
(A lonely space where time wanders alone. As if to indicate that Nornir's tears are coming to an end, the space that was initially morning gradually becomes darker and closer to night.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like I can see the passage of time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The space that was clearly morning when it started is now night... . I spent the whole day, but I never thought it would feel so short.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where are the tears of time? Even though I found all the paths, I still can't see them... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… .
(A huge side blade approaches %s, who is quickly running toward the darkening road.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Queen!!
(The Gremory Queen smiles at %s, who is retreating. Then, she rushes in at high speed and swings the side.)
(Adventurer tries to counterattack, but is blocked by the overwhelming Queen's attack and is thrown back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I guess you felt like you grew a little through the repetitive time, right? It won't reach me though.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How... .

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: As the queen of demons who control time, there's no way I wouldn't feel that way.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: The moment I realized that thanks to Nirvana, I would not have a future as a demon god, I felt truly unfair.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: God is also very ironic. They banish the Pluton Dragon that invaded God's domain, but give them eternal punishment by protecting God's domain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nirvana was originally the Pluton Dragon?)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I have received the Tears of Time exactly forty-six times since I entered this place, and yet I have to go back. I'm sick of it now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Forty-six times... ?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Yes. %s also died 46 times. Aren't you tired of it?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Isn't it? A lot of you in other timelines would have died anyway, so it would be worse than that.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: You are truly amazing. What kind of thing is it? He's just a human, how did he become like that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am just me.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Such an answer. You don't know yourself. Then I, who touched the tears of time, will tell you... … .
(In an instant, a sharp attack passes through the Gremory Queen's face. A wound appears on her pale face, and dark green blood drips from the gap.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: … Hehe.
(The Gremory Queen smiles lightly and caresses his cheek. The injured area then returns to its original state.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't want to hear that. There's no need to listen... .

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: So, let me tell you that I will only focus on the tears of time, so shall we have a fun time?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: It will be a lot of fun. Even though I was the messenger of God who would bring you back to life, I used up all my time and became a demonic beast with only my instincts left.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: The watchmen guarding this place also started going crazy.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: And I'll leave no trace of your soul. Now, I will finish the forty-seven times and become a demon god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth are demons going to do when they become gods? ?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: At least it would be better than someone who became a god even though he didn't want to.
(The Queen's words, which seem to refer to Iris, strengthen %s's hand holding the weapon.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: … It's like they're rushing to get rid of something.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Now, %s. Watch carefully. I see myself being reborn from the queen of the Gremory clan to the demon god Dahlia!!
(With the Gremory Queen's cry, the darkness within Nornir's tears speeds up and deepens. In this way, the time between the Queen and %s passes towards the end.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: A tenacious human being, to endure this far... .
(Adventurer struggles to block the Queen's attacks until the Gremory Queen's expression becomes distorted.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I never thought it would be more disgusting than the 32nd time.
(The horn on the queen's forehead turns into a sharp blade and stabs %s in the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, wow!!

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Do you still have the guts to hold on? It's been a long time since a human didn't give up even in this kind of pain... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, it can't be done!! I, I stop the Queen and the tears of time... .

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: It's sad to see.
(The Gremory Queen wipes the bloody horn and looks at the fallen figure of %s.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: There's no chance of winning in your time, so let's get it over with right away and painlessly.
(When the Queen smiles, the magic power hovering around the side explodes. At that moment, something passes the Gremory Queen's ears and flies into the air.)
(The Gremory Queen quickly turns her head after seeing that the object in Adventurer's hand has disappeared.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: That… … … .
(The Gremory Queen stretched out her hand and tried to use the power of time, but it was already aimed at the structure floating among Nornir's tears.)
(The object thrown by Adventurer may not have landed there, but when Nirvana wakes up, it catches the object and flies away and crashes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana?
Kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa!
(Nornir's tears are filled with a huge flash and a tremendous roar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, it’s dazzling… .
(When he raises his arm to cover his eyes, the light soon disappears. When the surprised Adventurer lowers his arm and looks forward, a strange scene approaches.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's stopped... .
(Queen is frozen just as she was trying to catch a flying object. Moreover, nothing can be felt from the sharp side that contained magic.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who would have thought that those moving among Nornir's tears were the tears of time.
「… If the worst comes to pass, use the key of time that fell from the timekeeper to save the tears of time... … .」
「… Destroy... .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just did as Nirvana said, and this is what happened. nirvana… ? nirvana!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana, where are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Answer me, Nirvana!! nirvana?
(%s, who was rushing to the spot where the tears of time were, stops.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Great job, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Archduke… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Even though I solved this situation by finding a way from Nirvana, the messenger of God... . Still, it was possible because of you.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Thanks to you, I got to visit this place after a long time.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: As Dahlia said, Nornir's Tears was a space where only those who could use time could enter... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The tears of time that could be said to be this place itself have disappeared, so it no longer has any meaning.
(Barvatos looks at the spot where the tears of time were with lonely eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened to Nirvana... ? I haven't seen it yet.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It was his choice. Nirvana, no, Sanak’s… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: He is a Plutonian dragon who was exiled for looking into the realm of God.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Still, God didn't hate him. I stayed in the Highlands where the tears of time fell, hoping to repent for my sins.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: When BEAST appeared... I don't know how it became a griffon, but it stayed in the Highlands in that form for a long time.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And it seems like he had a connection with the human girl.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: 10 years ago, when I opened my eyes and appeared. He must have come back here to protect the girl.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I don't know if he made this choice now to protect the girl like he did a long time ago when he protected God.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The fact that a person who was God's creation voluntarily destroyed an object containing God's power means that he was prepared to do so.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You probably know that the price for violating providence is extinction... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana... … .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I don't even know who the real owner is... . Well, that's it now.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I just wanted to get it because I needed it. Nirvana and Dahlia ruined everything.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I expected this from the moment Dahlia felt the power of God... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: %s, the hand holding the weapon is strong. If you fight here anyway, you will only lose.
(Barvatos laughs at %s's slightly surprised look.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You're still easy to figure out.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: God's realm, where time has disappeared, will soon flow into the gap between the great walls.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I have decided to leave the realm of God to God, and those who have not yet returned to God will have to leave. If you fall into a gap, it is difficult for even a great person to come out easily... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And the day of trial for you is coming soon... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos!!

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: … You can look forward to it and look forward to it.
(He tries to catch Barbatos, but a black butterfly appears from nowhere, circles around Barbatos, and then disappears together.)
(As you look at the spot where Barbatos disappeared, a black hole opens up in front of you. Through it, you can see the shadow of the monster you saw in Moksha.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to get out quickly... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where should I go?
(A small light comes in front of %s. The light seems to circle around %s and shows a path that was not visible until a moment ago.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I go over there? . I have no choice but to go there first... .

steps.name: Have a happy time
steps.objective: Talk to [Caluso] in the ‘Invernell Ruins’, visit ‘Pneuma’ and report the quest to [Arke].

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Priest Caluso.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: The power of that woman, the Gremory Queen, diminished. No, it seems to have stopped moving. He's not dead... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: And the faintly felt power of the Archduke disappeared.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: If Barbatos is gone, it obviously means there's nothing more to do here. %s either succeeded or failed.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It can be considered a success. Look over there, priest.
(A mysterious light rushes in front of the door on the side Romalius pointed to and rises like a pillar of a temple.)
(And where the light disappeared, there stood the person they were waiting for.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it outside... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s, you're back.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Are you okay, %s? It's been less than 10 minutes since you received the prayer... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: 10 minutes?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Looking at %s's reaction, it seems like the flow of time is different there than here.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Anyway, I'm glad you came back safely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: %s, if you don't mind, could you briefly explain the situation inside?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: The moment I said that prayer, I think the Pope knew it too... . Still, I think it needs to be reported separately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since I received help from a priest, of course I will tell you. therefore… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Caluso briefly what happened in Nornir's Tears, including the repetition of time forty-six times.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: That's quite an interesting story... .

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Trisha's griffon was a messenger from God, and in order to protect everyone, she destroyed God's objects and disappeared... .

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: When I heard that Barbatos would become a god, I thought it was a lie... .

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: The Archduke is no longer in Highland, and the Gremory Queen is trapped in a world where time has stopped and seems to have flowed into another gap in time and space.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's resolved for now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Even after coming here, I saw that time slowed down and didn’t move back….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's all over. Can we go back to Iris then?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… ?
(I don’t know when it appeared, but a small sphere of light approaches and hovers near %s.)

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: %s, thank goodness.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: … Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Hello, Priest Caluso.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: It’s an honor to call you by name, Iris… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: I was a little anxious because I couldn't find %s, but I'm okay now.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: It's back to normal again. I'm glad I can hear your voice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a lot to tell Iris. I have a place to go first before I return to Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Yes, I will wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah.
(With %s's answer, the holy light is carried by the blowing wind and disappears somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: … I never dreamed that I would see the sacred light so close.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I also wanted to hear the goddess's voice, but I guess it was impossible because I was a demon. Phew. I can't help it. Should I be born again?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Cheer up, demon youth. When the time comes, the goddess will understand Romalius's intentions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Are you finished with your work here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm going to tell Trisha about Nirvana and go back.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: … I will tell Trisha about it when I have the chance. I think you might be too confused right now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… . Then, priest, let me ask you a favor.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye to you too, Romalius. You're doing well at your part-time job.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Nice to meet you, %s. May happy times be with you in Nornir.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I hope you return home safely. %s. May happy times be with you in Nornir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s a happy time….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will do my best to make it a happy time for Nornir.

steps.name: To Pneuma and Elysia
steps.objective: Talk to [Arke] in “Pneuma” and go to [Irfan] in “Elysia”. Then report the quest to [Ellie] in “Bigrid”.

lines.text: (As soon as Arche sees the face of %s visiting Pneuma, he rushes over and hugs her.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, I'm glad you're safe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arke, Sue, I'm suffocating.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry.
(Arke’s eyes are swollen as he steps back.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oops… … . My eyes are very swollen.
(At Arke’s hand gesture, Aerura flies out from somewhere and rubs Arke’s face.)
(Then, miraculously, the swelling around my eyes disappeared.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does Aerura have a purpose like this?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's more helpful than useful, hehe.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: As %s's time returns, the spirits in Pneuma have also regained their vitality!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness. Chronos and Kairos are also okay, right?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I can't tell you how happy I am to see these two fighting so hard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'd like to tell you that it's okay now and that nothing will happen, but I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I am afraid that something will happen to %s and Iris in the future.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It'll be okay. Arche. So don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia wouldn't want to see Arche anxious either.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Are you on your way to meet Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm going to leave after saying hello to the people who helped me.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I see. Irrfan is next, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I'm sorry, Arche. Because I couldn't stay long.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No, %s. Instead, you can come again next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will definitely do that. See you later then.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: There you are.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Mr. Irfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You don't need to thank me. Leave it to him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please say thank you to Hecate.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I don't feel sincere. Anyway, I'll tell you what Hecate said.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: He praised me for resolving a situation that seemed like the God of Mischief had intervened surprisingly well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay to be praised, but this situation is no joke... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Is there anything else you want to say?  In that case, do it after you catch and kill the snake that was playing around.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I don't know if it's fortunate or not, but now you can freely go to places that used to be the other side of the world.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The road to the other side of Yggdrasil is no longer closed.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Don't be so surprised and just go.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It seems like there are people waiting for news from you there too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Irfan. See you later then.

steps.name: crack in time
steps.objective: Talk to [Ellie] in “Vigrid” and meet [Iris] in the “Oracle Room” in “Sanctuary Eidos” to report the quest.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: How did you get back here? wait for a sec… .
(Ellie is smiling, but there are tears in her eyes. She wipes them away with her sleeve, but she cannot hide her tears of joy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Yeah, it's okay.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I trusted you. I will solve everything that happens behind you and in front of you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to Ellie.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I don't know who asked me to say hello. And I couldn’t remember what I said back then… .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: No. You already said hello. thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What does that mean... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You don't have to notice right now. Someday you will find out. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: … I'd like to hear your story, but you're only here in Bigrid for a short time, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, you need to meet Iris.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Okay, okay. It looks like you need some Iris rest now. Even if you say it's okay, you've experienced various passages of time with your whole body... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'm sorry there's nothing I can do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Ellie.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You don’t know how happy I am to hear you say that. therefore… .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Please come visit often in the future.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Then go now… . You can go back to the place where you first met me in Bigrid.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you next time, Ellie.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't have time, so I'll have to see Adkina and Gendia later... I have to go to Iris first...)
(Ellie waves her hand loudly as she watches %s leave.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Jiendia must have met Prince Kii again by now. Take care, Gendia.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Ouroboros... ?
(Iris, who came to meet %s, smiles brightly as soon as he sees their face. Adventurer, who was relaxed, sits down as if relieved.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . Stop without even realizing it... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, no problem.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Me too, but %s always says it's okay.
(Iris extends his hand to the fallen %s, allowing him to get up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris. A lot has happened. I wish it had come a little sooner... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did anything happen to Iris while I was like this?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I couldn't move easily. If you try to approach %s, the time including the great wall may become unstable... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Iris. I want to rest, but I have a lot of things I want to talk about with Iris. Is this time okay?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: We have plenty of time. So don't be too hasty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Time….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What do we talk about with Iris?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: His Majesty told me to just watch, but the moment I stepped forward to save Giendia... . As of today, time and space were divided into two sides: the back side and the front side.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After solving the problem of Vigrid, the time and space behind me, I returned to the time and space in front of me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I experienced time repeating itself several times while fighting the Gremory Queen, who was after the treasure in the realm of time, the Tear of Time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was able to escape by following Nirvana's instructions, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What would have happened if I had followed His Majesty's prophecy? I didn't think anything until a little while ago, but the moment I saw Iris, I started thinking that way.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will tell you everything from the best of my knowledge.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The future that Emperor Kaina sees is not one. I also went to Highland via Bigrid... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, that’s… . That means… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You combined several pieces of the future and presented the best direction. And I left the rest to %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: … … I think he knew that he would save Gendia, and that he would come back after resolving everything... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, Adkina once said something like that. His Majesty's abilities are almost god-like... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe it's a superhuman or something like them.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know if such a thing exists. Still, as I learned about Nornir's tears and was influenced by them, I learned one thing.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Even Emperor Kaina sees the cracks in the great wall.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then everything makes sense. I understand it, but… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I know this is hard to accept. This is all I can say about your Majesty... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. The rest will work out somehow later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I need to know what Your Majesty is hiding.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you ever felt Iris? Time went back several times in Nornir's tears... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, even though I couldn't get close... . In it, all the moments when everything about %s disappeared... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Forty-six times, all of that... .
(Iris nods with sad eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should have solved it a little sooner.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's okay. It's in front of me like this now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. If Iris is ok, it's ok, right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's right. If it's okay with me, it's okay. Who can say that Etoire's star scene is okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, Iris. As you may know, I have been different in many different times.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know which one is the real me, but I guess the me standing here in front of Iris is the real me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I vaguely remember it. At some point, the name of Iris appeared as if it were engraved in my mind, and I began to believe that I had to meet Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Regardless of my past or will, I believe that it is my job to be with Iris, as if it were fate, and of course, regardless of that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I have something to ask. Iris Since when did you get to know me?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: When I was dreaming, the moment I needed someone... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The door opened and I saw a path. And I saw %s inside it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I saw that door in my dream too... . Sorry, I don't think I saw Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Anyway, I was glad we were able to meet each other.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The road of dreams, was that really a dream?...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There are many places in the Time Realm other than Nornir's Tears. I don't know what it looks like, but... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: They will have different appearances, as if time is infinite.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, that means… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If something like this happens again in the future, we'll have to go to a place like Nornir's Tears.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll make sure that doesn't happen as I continue to look at the Great Wall.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So the Gremory Queen is trapped inside with time frozen?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, it will be there, neither alive nor dead. Only affected by the time I wanted so much... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was the Archduke even aiming for this…? .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If there was a god nearby who knew about Barbatos, he would at least ask, but I still don't have much information.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: God who knows the Duke... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I thought of him too, but I know it would be difficult to get out of Elysia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then you'll have no choice but to find out for yourself...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you talking about Hilda's friend who came with the cat? They said they fought a lot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Lepika came to the right place. thank god.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Like Hilda, Lepika was running away because she didn't want to hurt anyone or die.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s Thanks to you, I'm so happy to meet someone I can have fun talking to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad Iris is someone I can have fun talking to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where is Lepika now?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's where Hilda used to stay. It is a place where I can only stay if I have my own will.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Let's go together when the time comes. With friends.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Don't worry too much about Lepika. Because he is a kind, active and positive person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, okay. Thank you, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: What?
(There are a few black cat furs on Iris's shoulders.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm, what kind of place is Iris talking about? I’m curious, but let’s wait for later….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Iris, I… . Can I rest here for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I'm falling asleep because I'm so relaxed. I'm sleepy… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's okay. As much as you want.
(After hearing Iris's answer, Adventurer lays down in the flower garden behind. Then, looking at Iris in front, he closes his eyes and goes to sleep.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It would be uncomfortable without a pillow... . Is there nothing to replace it? My grandmother always hit the pillow when I sleep like this... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: … grandma… ?
(While Iris was looking for a pillow substitute for %s's head, he was surprised when the word "grandmother" suddenly came out of his mouth.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Why did I forget about my grandmother all this time... … … ?!
Did you forget that because you wanted to forget it?
(A small, dark sphere appears in front of Iris. The faint light flowing from the sphere gradually spreads and fills the space of the oracle room where Iris is located.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: … … Hecate? Hecate?
(As the light that spreads like fog spreads and disappears, a woman dressed in black appears in the middle of it and approaches Iris.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Iris. The child who succeeded Ceres.
(Hekyate looks at Iris and smiles lightly. Then, he hugs her gently and whispers softly in her ear.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I was telling my story with mortals.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hecate, that’s… .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Kid, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to scare you. Understand.
(Hecate steps back and looks around.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: This must be one of Gaia's rooms, and you're using it.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: How did you get here?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Let's say it's thanks to the sleeping mortals and the tears of time. .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hey kid.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I have something for you. What I gave to Ceres is what you received from Ceres.
(Hecate quietly moves her gaze to the collapsed %s. Adventurer is still in a deep sleep, unaware that the Goddess of the Black Moon has come.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Baby, you know what I want.  Don't be scared.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I came to receive it myself, but I won't just ask for it.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Kid, no. Holy Spirit Iris. I will give you a special opportunity.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: A way to live as a human being, an ordinary person, not a god... .
